description: Main application shell widget for the admin panel of a Flutter-based mobile platform. It manages navigation, session validation, and layout including sidebar and top bar, integrating multiple pages like dashboard, books, categories, and users.

classes.name: AdminPanelShell
classes.description: Main shell widget for admin panel, facilitating navigation, layout, and authentication state management.

classes.name: _AdminSideBar
classes.description: Sidebar widget containing navigation items and sign out button.

classes.name: _AdminTopBar
classes.description: Top bar widget displaying admin panel title and user info.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes navigation routes, checks user session, and sets up force logout callback.

methods.name: _checkSession
methods.description: Reads stored tokens to determine if the user is authenticated.

methods.name: _signout
methods.description: Logs out the user via API, updates state, and navigates to login screen.
